title: Groups and arrays
summary: Read arrays both ways, find missing groups, and spot unequal groups.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 counts 3 rows of 5 on an array (15). Q2 picks the same total as 2 rows of 10. Q3 sees 3 rows of 5 and knows 5 rows of 3 is the same total. Q4 matches a 2 by 5 array to 5 rows of 2. Q5 finds how many groups of 5 make 20. Q6 spots the unequal groups. Q7 shares 30 equally between 3. Q8 taps two arrays with the same total. Q9 finds how many groups of 10 from 30. Q10 sees 4 rows of 5 and 5 rows of 4 as the same.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses small equal groups of 2 and 5, totals to 10, sharing into 2, and grouping 10 into twos. Medium uses totals to 30, groups of 10, and grouping versus sharing stories. Hard reads an array both ways, finds a missing number of groups, and spots unequal groups. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not just bigger numbers.
